1
Bullah Ki Jana Main Kaun?
Na Main Momin Wich Maseetan.
Na Main Wich Kufar Di Reet Aaan.
Na Main Pakaan Wich Paleet Aaan.
Na Main Mosa Na Firon.
Na Main Wich Paleeti Paki.
Na Wich Shadi Na Ghamnaki.
Nain Main Aabi Na Main Khaki.
Na Main Aatish Na Main Paun.
Na Main Bheait Mazab Da Paya.
Na Main Adam Hawa Jaya.
Na Kuj Apna Naam Duhraya.
Na Wich Bethan Na Wich Bhaun.
Awal Akhir Aap Nu Jana.
Na Koi Doja Hoor Pachana.
Metho Wadh Na Koi Siyana.
 Bullah Ohh Khara Hai Kaun.

item.text:
Reconstructed the [selected lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/62ca6bb960e5490b801291d2d6875ce9/src/data/lyrics/bullah-ki-jana-main-kaun-lyrics-in-punjabi-2017-tajpoints-90bf6819805fb1241184.md) in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions contain 17 verses in one stanza. Updated the title and script metadata and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Bhaun” as `بھون` and “Bethan” as `بیٹھاں`.
